g.text: Single-step interventions can reverse outward drift at the same saved state
Cohort: proxies already outside raw cap before each step. Top-row y scales differ; all values are labelled.
Each intervention starts from the same saved parameter/current gradient/second moment/step. Changing eps preserves native historical m and v.
Only a private CPU optimizer clone takes one step; these results do not predict a retrained trajectory or classification accuracy.
